description: Read the gateway's current configuration. Wraps `config.get`. Read-only. The gateway returns the full config; pass `path` to project to a sub-section client-side after fetch (the gateway itself does NOT support a `path` filter — verified live against 2026.4.12+).

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

path.description: Dotted path applied client-side to project the response (e.g. 'channels.telegram'). Does not reduce wire traffic — the gateway always returns the full config.

name: openclaw_config_get
